about_short_description.short_description: Stonly provides interactive knowledge base and guidance software for customer support, self-service, and employee training.

product.name: Stonly Knowledge Platform
product.description: A knowledge management platform for creating, organizing, governing, translating, and analyzing interactive support and training content.

product.name: Stonly Interactive Guides
product.description: Interactive, step-by-step guides that help customers, support agents, and employees complete processes, troubleshoot issues, and follow decision-based workflows.

identifier.value: Stonly AI Agent Assist and AI Answers

product.name: Stonly AI Agent Assist and AI Answers
product.description: AI capabilities that summarize support tickets, identify resolution paths, generate responses, and provide answers from an organization’s structured knowledge.

product.name: Stonly Knowledge Base
product.description: A customer- and agent-facing knowledge base for publishing organized help content, interactive guides, troubleshooting instructions, and process documentation.

product.name: Stonly Widget and In-Product Guidance
product.description: An embeddable widget for delivering contextual knowledge, interactive guides, onboarding experiences, and support resources within digital products or workflows.

product.name: Stonly Integrations and API
product.description: Integration and API capabilities that connect Stonly knowledge and guidance with support, CRM, service-management, and AI systems.
